limitations: All candidate tokens require Jim review; all third-party logos require project permission before public use.
One original image per token, not about 18 images per engine slot. Seven STX.City token logos plus one BLOCKS logo and the official STX SVG are bundled.
Faktory comparative market/volume ranking could not be verified. Its historical BLOCKS prelaunch seat is verified from public on-chain source and transactions.
Moonshot scope is the eligible STX.City snapshot only. Never claim this is the biggest by market capitalization or on both launchpads.
All numeric token displays are dated snapshots; no current rates, supplies, seat availability, or live trading counts are implied.

The retained token originals use the project artwork referenced by Hiro image_uri, obtained through STX.City image proxy at up to 640px. Runtime images are 480px contain WebP derivatives (quality 90, with lossless encoding for the two flat logos); full original files, sizes and hashes are retained. No cropping, redrawing, intentional recolouring or stretching. The official Stacks SVG is byte-for-byte unchanged.

Rejected after visual screening: Stacking Turtle (recognizable Squirtle-like character); Rocket Van (VW-style vehicle emblem); ZEROPOINTS (borrowed meme-face artwork). Their files are not in the bundle.
Names were screened against offensive, real-person-mocking, tragedy/disease and obvious copycat themes. This is a visual/content screen, not an independent trademark clearance.
